# The Bright Morrow's Night Run

*Sail the Bright Morrow's night run past the headland in Keziah's place. The sawbills leap across the deck in the dark; keep them off the mainsail until the run is done. Potions work; scrolls do not.*

## 1. The Night Run

Map: [The Bright Morrow, by Night](../maps/bright_morrow_deck.md)

- Keep the sawbills off the deck until the run is done

Wave 1: 3 [Sawbill Fry](../monsters/sawbill_fry.md), 1 [Sawbill](../monsters/sawbill.md)

Wave 2: 1 [Spitting Sawbill](../monsters/spitting_sawbill.md), 1 [Sawbill](../monsters/sawbill.md)

## Rewards (Normal)

First clear: 9,000 EXP, [Harbour Loaf](../items/harbour_loaf.md) x3, +40 standing with Bain Harbour

Every clear: 3,000 EXP, 1,500 mesos, [Sailor's Biscuit](../items/sailors_biscuit.md) x3
